pageProps.content: ## Overview of Ballerina Swan Lake Update 13 (2201.13.2) Swan Lake Update 13 (2201.13.2) is the second patch release of Ballerina 2201.13.0 (Swan Lake Update 13). It includes improvements to dependency resolution. ## Update Ballerina Run the command below to update your current Ballerina installation directly to 2201.13.2 by using the [Ballerina Update Tool](/learn/update-tool/). ``` $ bal dist pull 2201.13.2 ``` ## Install Ballerina If you have not installed Ballerina, then, download the [installers](/downloads/#swanlake) to install.
